nameJa: アイコニック・ブラック
headline: Fullscreen. Live Chat.
prompt:
Use case: text-localization / ads-marketing. Edit the attached exact black/red promotional tile for the extension YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen.
Critical change: replace the two-line main headline with exactly:
"Fullscreen."
"Live Chat."
Fullscreen is one word: F-u-l-l-s-c-r-e-e-n. No space inside it. Capital F then lowercase remaining letters. Live Chat has capital L and C and one space. Preserve the periods. These must be the ONLY words in the artwork.
Keep this as a compact landscape 11:7 tile, 1760 pixels wide by 1120 pixels tall, never a panoramic banner. Keep both complete words comfortably within the canvas with at least 6% margins and no clipping. Large warm off-white heavy grotesk type in the lower third, readable at 220 x 140 pixels.
Preserve the original matte near-black, vermilion red, off-white, subtle paper grain, and the central original emblem combining a red play triangle, off-white speech bubble, and fullscreen corner brackets. Recompose the emblem slightly only if needed to give the new headline breathing room. No new objects, text, gradients, official logos, badge, UI, watermark, or physical monitor. One finished store-listing concept.
conceptNote: 黒地の再生・吹き出し・全画面シンボルを保ち、両方の必須語を大きな白い見出しに置いた。
